name: local-gpu
description: Per-session toggle for the local-gpu MCP server, with a pane splitting Claude and local-model work and estimating savings

url.title: Server URL
url.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint of the local-gpu MCP server, e.g. http://desktop:8765/mcp

token.title: Bearer token
token.description: The LGM_TOKEN the server was started with

defaultOn.title: On at session start
defaultOn.description: Whether local GPU tools are usable until you run /local off

inputPricePerMTok.title: Claude input price ($ per million tokens)
inputPricePerMTok.description: Price of the Claude model you would otherwise use, for savings estimates

outputPricePerMTok.title: Claude output price ($ per million tokens)
outputPricePerMTok.description: Price of the Claude model you would otherwise use, for savings estimates
